$comment: What AOBPRINTER emits for one DB4 printed from PracSoft3. Extends the existing PrintJobEnvelopeDto (POST /inbound/print-jobs) with a fifth documentType. Carl, 14 Sep 2026 (D-2026-09-14-02 and -03): the Signed-DB4 is our deterministic reproduction of this form with the cost and the patient's signature on it, so EVERYTHING printed on the form travels, including the Medicare card number and IRN, which the patient recognises and which the auditor uses to link the form to a valid Medicare number. Hard rule 1 is unchanged in what it actually says: the Medicare number is never an IDENTITY identifier — never used to verify who the patient is, never used to find or match a patient, never in a log or an event, never sent to the rules service. It is content on the form, like the patient's name. The pathology tick box is carried as data and never acted on (s 65C(4) items 1-4 out of scope). The driver never asserts the form's version; the server decides that from formCode and parserTemplateVersion. Identities below are the scanned example's; in fixtures use obviously fake ones with an INVALID Medicare checksum.

heading.$comment: The four heading lines as printed, in order. Carl: 'We need to print this on the page.' See section 2a of the plan before rendering line 3 on OUR artefact — it is the government saying its form is approved, and hard rule 12 forbids us saying it of ours.
lines: BULK BILL ASSIGNMENT OF BENEFIT FORM
This form is the approved form as prescribed under section 20A of the Health Insurance Act 1973
Bulk bill claim for assessment by Services Australia

patient.$comment_medicare: Printed on the Signed-DB4 in full (D-2026-09-14-03). Not an identifier: never verification, never lookup, never logs, never the rules service.

services.description: Professional attendance (the attendance service) by a general practitioner, a medical practitioner or a prescribed medical practitioner, at which a general practice support service is provided

assignment.$comment: The privacy notice and the two statements as printed, so they can be versioned content later rather than hardcoded. 'ticked' is what the driver could see on the page. The statements are joined by 'or' on the form. The second statement is a pathology assignment and is out of this product's scope (s 65C(4) items 1-4): it is carried as data and never acted on.
privacyNotice: Privacy Notice: Your personal information is protected by law, including the Privacy Act 1988, and is collected by Services Australia for the assessment and administration of payments and services. This information is required to process your application or claim.
Your information may be used by the agency or given to other parties for the purposes of research, investigation or where you have agreed or it is required or authorised by law.

You can get more information about the way in which the Services Australia will manage your personal information, including our privacy policy at servicesaustralia.gov.au/privacy or by requesting a copy from the agency.
Information about medical/dental expenses for people under the age of 18 may also be disclosed to adults on the same Medicare card, through taxation statements.
To be completed by the person assigning benefits for the services stated on this form.

statements.text: I assign my right to benefits to the health professional who rendered the services.
I offer to assign my right to benefits to the Approved Pathology Practitioner who will render the requested pathology services.
